The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's replanning at Step 35. Its updated fact sheet listed as "GIVEN OR VERIFIED" that the $99 2025 Gold Pass "includes unlimited visits and free parking for both the 2024 and 2025 seasons." The pages it had read only showed 2025 pass pricing, with WinterFest and 2024 perks mentioned only in passing. That unsupported claim anchored the new plan on the wrong pass and the wrong year. The plan then sent WebSurfer back to the same current-year sales pages instead of looking for archived 2024 season-pass and daily-ticket prices, which were needed to compute the $55 difference. The earlier looping and scrolling were inefficient but did not set the failure path.
